composition_narrative.how_parts_connect: Each leaf is a welded frame of four horizontal rails and vertical pickets. Decorative bands (circles, basket twists, spears) attach between or on pickets. Leaves hinge on external posts and meet at a central latch plate. The arched top rail sets the silhouette; finials follow the curve on every picket.
composition_narrative.why_layout: Arched profile and finials express Victorian identity. The spear band and dense lower zone reduce perceived gap at the base (pets/security). Symmetric double leaves suit wide driveways. Decorative bands break up vertical repetition without closing the gate like composite panels.
distinctive_features: Swan-neck arched top with peak at center meeting
